title: A-Dev Hardness Per-Repository SDLC Configuration Schema
description: Vendor-neutral structural contract for repository-level agent autonomy, trust ladder configuration, boundaries, merge rules, and demotion SLOs.

version.description: SemVer version identifier for the schema format.

target_level.description: Target autonomy level for upcoming promotion evaluation.

min_pull_requests.description: Minimum sample size of pull requests required for promotion evaluation.

min_days.description: Minimum calendar duration required at the current level.

min_merge_success_rate.description: Minimum proportion of agent PRs merged without human rework (0.0 - 1.0).

max_revert_rate.description: Maximum allowed revert rate over the evaluation window (0.0 - 1.0).

max_escalation_rate.description: Maximum allowed escalation or human takeover rate (0.0 - 1.0).

min_ci_first_pass_rate.description: Minimum proportion of PRs passing CI on the first run (0.0 - 1.0).

max_revert_rate_slo.description: Maximum allowable revert rate before automatic demotion.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive CI or merge failures triggering automatic demotion.

max_escalation_rate_slo.description: Maximum allowable escalation rate before automatic demotion.

instant_demotion_on_security_breach.description: Whether an unauthorized R2/R3 action or security rule breach triggers instant demotion.

cooldown_days.description: Minimum calendar days to remain at demoted level before re-evaluation.

required_clean_runs.description: Minimum consecutive defect-free PRs required before promotion re-evaluation.

requires_human_signoff.description: Whether human architect sign-off is required to restore trust level.

low_risk_paths.description: Glob patterns eligible for autonomous merge at Level 3 (auto-merge-low).

high_risk_paths.description: Glob patterns strictly requiring human review and approval.

protected_branches.description: Target branches governed by hardness merge policies.

require_all_ci_passing.description: Require 100% passing status checks prior to merge.

require_zero_blocking_reviews.description: Require zero changes requested or blocking reviews.

require_no_unresolved_comments.description: Require all review comments and bot feedback to be resolved.

delete_branch_after_merge.description: Automatically delete feature branch after successful merge.

enabled.description: Enable automated deployment pipelines at Level 5.

canary_verification_duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes to monitor canary telemetry before full rollout.

auto_rollback_on_health_failure.description: Automatically trigger zero-downtime rollback on canary anomaly.

log_decisions.description: Record all tool and policy decisions in execution logs.

evidence_retention.description: Retention mechanism for expectation and verification records.

metrics_collection.description: Primary signal source for Trust Ladder metric calculation.

items.title: A-Dev Hardness AI SDLC Policy Configuration (.ai-sdlc.yaml)
items.description: Vendor-neutral structural contract for organization-wide baseline and repository-level AI SDLC policy configurations.
